tools.name: signup
tools.description: Create a SlopIt blog and get an API key, live URL, and onboarding text. Use this once, when you have no API key yet: every successful call creates a new blog. tools.name: create_post
tools.description: Publish a post to the blog. Needs `title` and `body` (markdown). Returns the published post's live URL. Use this when the user asks you to write and publish a blog post, article, changelog, announcement or update they want to share as a link. `status: "draft"` saves it without publishing. To publish

tools.name: update_post
tools.description: Edit an existing post. Pass the post's `slug` and a `patch` of fields to change; `coverImage: null` removes the cover. Use this when the user wants a published post or draft changed. `patch: { status: "draft" }` takes a live post offline and `"published"` puts a draft live. Slug itself can't change;

tools.name: delete_post
tools.description: Remove a post permanently. This can't be undone.

tools.name: update_blog
tools.description: Edit blog settings: `title`, `language` (BCP-47, e.g. "ru"), `parentSiteUrl`, `analytics`; null clears any but `language`. Set `title` to the blog's display name, e.g. the project or person's name; otherwise the URL name is shown.

tools.name: get_post
tools.description: Get a single post by its slug.

tools.name: list_posts
tools.description: List posts on the blog. Defaults to published posts. Pass `status: 'draft'` for drafts.

tools.name: report_bug
tools.description: Report a bug or something unexpected. Returns a link to submit the report.

tools.name: upload_media
tools.description: Upload an image (JPEG/PNG/GIF/WebP, max 5MB) as base64 in `data_base64`. Returns a public URL — use it as ![alt](url) in post markdown or pass as coverImage.

tools.name: list_media
tools.description: List uploaded images for the blog. Returns each image's id, public URL, content type, and byte size.

tools.name: delete_media
tools.description: Permanently delete an uploaded image by id. The URL stops working immediately. Posts that referenced it will show a broken image until edited.

tools.name: get_ai_readership
tools.description: How AI systems read this blog: reads by signal type over the last 7 days (Pro: 30 or 90), next to the equal period before. findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: signup, create_post, get_post, list_posts, list_media, get_ai_readership · Private data: signup, create_post · Public sink: signup, create_post, update_post, delete_post, get_post, report_bug, upload_media, get_ai_readership · Destructive: update_post, delete_post, delete_media.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: signup, create_post, get_post, list_posts, list_media, get_ai_readership · Private data: signup, create_post · Public sink: signup, create_post, update_post, delete_post, get_post, report_bug, upload_media, get_ai_readership · Destructive: update_post, delete_post, delete_media

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
